Center]] |champion= |tourney= [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = First Round }} {{2018–19 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Louisville]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team played its home games on Denny Crum Court at the [[KFC Yum! Center]] in [[downtown Louisville|downtown Louisville, Kentucky]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They were led by first-year head coach [[Chris Mack (basketball)|Chris Mack]] who was hired on March 27, 2018, after it was announced interim coach [[David Padgett]] would not be retained.{{cite news|url=https://247sports.com/Article/David-Padgett-Louisville-part-ways-116528705|title=David Padgett, Louisville part ways|first=Evan|last=Daniels|website=247sports.com|date=March 21, 2018|accessdate=March 21, 2018}}{{cite news|last1=Greer|first1=Jeff|title=Louisville hires Chris Mack as new men's basketball coach|url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/louisville/2018/03/27/louisville-basketball-chris-mack-hired-xavier-coach/418999002/|accessdate=March 27, 2018|publisher=Courier Journal|date=March 27, 2018}} They finished the season 20–14, to finish in 7th place. In the ACC Tournament, they beat [[2018–19 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team|Notre Dame]] in the Second Round before losing to [[2018–19 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] in the Quarterfinals. They received a at-large bid to the NCAA Tournament and received a 7th seed before losing to 10th seed [[2018–19 Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball team|Minnesota]] in the First Round. ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|Cardinals]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] with a record of 22–14, 9–9 in [[2017–18 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]], finishing in a tie for 8th with [[2017–18 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]], who they defeated in the second round of the [[2018 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] before losing to [[2017–18 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]] in the quarterfinals. They received an invitation to the [[2018 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]], where they defeated [[2017–18 Northern Kentucky Norse men's basketball team|Northern Kentucky]] in the first round and [[2017-18 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team|Middle Tennessee]] in the second round before being defeated in the quarterfinals by [[2017–18 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Mississippi State]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
